title: Playing with text
description:
Write three string functions:

```python
def initials(name): ...          # "ada lovelace" -> "A.L."; "Grace Brewster Hopper" -> "G.B.H."
def is_palindrome(text): ...     # reads the same backwards, ignoring case and anything that is not a letter
def count_vowels(text): ...      # how many of a, e, i, o, u (either case)
```

Names may have extra spaces between or around the words.
hints: `name.split()` with no argument splits on any run of whitespace and ignores spaces at the ends.
For the palindrome, first build a string of only the lower-case letters, then compare it with its reverse `s[::-1]`.
